question: Add a new method ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error to the Config interface, replacing the existing Validate() error method. Every component config across the OTel ecosystem must implement context-aware validation.

interface_definition_changes.description: The Validator interface in confmap/xconfmap/config.go must be changed from Validate() error to ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error. The component.Config type alias in component/config.go references xconfmap.Validator and must be updated accordingly.

files.reason: Defines the Validator interface with Validate() error method, the callValidateIfPossible() function that type-asserts and calls Validate(), and the recursive Validate() function that walks config structs. All must accept and propagate context.Context.
Defines the base Config type for all OTel Collector components, requiring xconfmap.Validator. The type constraint comment and documentation must reflect ValidateWithContext.

validation_callers.description: All files that call Validate() or xconfmap.Validate() on config objects must be updated to pass a context.Context.

files.reason: Top-level config Validate() method that validates all component configs. Must accept ctx and propagate to sub-validations.
The validate CLI command that calls cfg.Validate(). Must pass context.
Calls config validation during collector startup. Must propagate context.
Test utility that optionally validates loaded configs. Must pass context.
Test utility for loading configs without validation. May need signature updates.
CheckConfigStruct utility that validates config struct patterns. Must work with the new ValidateWithContext signature.

shared_config_helper_types.description: These shared config types in the config/ package have their own Validate() methods that are called recursively by the validation engine. Each must be updated to ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error.

files.reason: ClientConfig.Validate() and ServerConfig.Validate() methods for gRPC configuration.
ClientConfig.Validate() method for HTTP client configuration.
Config.Validate() and ServerConfig.Validate() methods for TLS configuration.
AddrConfig.Validate() method for network address configuration.

core_component_configs_with_validate.description: These config.go files in the core opentelemetry-collector repo define Config structs with Validate() methods that must be updated to ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error.

contrib_impact.description: opentelemetry-collector-contrib has 202 non-generated config.go files with validation logic and 223 total (including generated). These span receivers, exporters, processors, connectors, and extensions that all implement Validate() and must be updated.

code_generation_impact.description: The mdatagen code generator produces generated_config.go files with Validate() methods. The generation templates must be updated to emit ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error.

test_files_requiring_update.description: Test files that call Validate() directly or test validation behavior must be updated to pass context.

summary.total_impacted_files_core_repo: ~40+ source files (17 component configs + 7 shared config helpers + 6 callers/infrastructure + test files + code generators)
summary.total_impacted_files_contrib: 223 config files with validation across the contrib repo
summary.migration_strategy: 1) Change Validator interface in confmap/xconfmap/config.go to ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error. 2) Update callValidateIfPossible and recursive Validate to accept/propagate ctx. 3) Update all shared config types (configgrpc, confighttp, configtls, confignet, configretry). 4) Update all core component configs. 5) Update mdatagen templates for generated configs. 6) Update all contrib component configs (202+ files). 7) Update all test files.
